name: Security review
description: Scoped scan -> triage -> suggested remediation -> retest. Produces findings with evidence and explicit scope.

steps.title: Scan {{scope}}
steps.acceptance: Scope stated explicitly; every finding has evidence.
steps.instructions: Scan {{scope}} for security issues (secrets, injection, unsafe file access). Read-only. Record file and line for each finding.

steps.title: Triage findings for {{scope}}
steps.acceptance: Each finding has severity and rationale; false positives marked.
steps.instructions: Triage the findings for {{scope}}. Assign severity and mark false positives with reasons.

steps.title: Remediation for {{scope}}
steps.instructions: Propose or implement remediation for the triaged findings in {{scope}}.

steps.title: Retest {{scope}}
steps.acceptance: Original findings re-checked with results recorded.
steps.instructions: Re-run the checks for {{scope}} and record which findings are resolved.
